cards.card_text: David says may it whirl over the head of Joab and his father's whole house, and may that house never be without someone with a discharge or skin disease, someone who leans on a staff, falls by the sword or lacks food.
cards.verse_text: May it whirl over the head of Joab and over the entire house of his father, and may the house of Joab never be without one having a discharge or skin disease, or one who leans on a staff or falls by the sword or lacks food.”
